from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib
p,o=map(Path,sys.argv[1:]);
def report():
 import base64,csv,io,re
 b=base64.b64decode(p.read_bytes(),validate=True) if not p.read_bytes().endswith(b'\n') else base64.b64decode(p.read_bytes().strip(),validate=True)
 rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(b.decode('utf-8-sig'))))
 titles=[{'title_en':r['title-titre-eng'],'title_fr':r['title-titre-fra'],'publication':r['publicationDate-datePublication'],'status':r['tenderStatus-appelOffresStatut-eng']} for r in rows]
 pattern=r'spreadsheet|csv|reconcil|data quality|data integri|migration|validat|cleans|data entry|nettoyage|rapprochement|qualit.{0,5} des donn'
 return {'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'row_count':len(rows),'title_matches':[t for t in titles if re.search(pattern,t['title_en']+' '+t['title_fr'],re.I)],'titles':titles,'limit':'New notices feed only. Title screening does not verify independently priced scope or cover all open notices. No original notice inspected.'}
o.write_text(json.dumps(report(),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n'); print(o.read_text())
